title: An overflowing accumulator and its original JSON number text
summary: On the same strict JsonReader, every one-digit extension of 2⁶⁴ is a number and retains all 21 decimal characters.

change.description: On the same strict JsonReader, every one-digit extension of 2⁶⁴ is a number and retains all 21 decimal characters.

notes: The frozen independent observation table has 13 rows. Each property identifies its own input range. The subject JDK is Temurin 21.0.13.

For every decimal suffix after 2⁶⁴, the parent threw MalformedJsonException at peek(). The fix returned NUMBER and the same reader returned all 21 original characters. Both revisions accept 10 and reject 00 and 01.
The selected char-array range now constructs an immutable String snapshot. The existing arithmetic and reader models handled the signed 64-bit wrap and the separate overflow flag.
